entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call is very important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, this is Sarah, how can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I want to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little while back and I want to send it back. I'm not happy with it.
Okay, I understand. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the order?
It's [customer provides email address]. And hurry up, I don’t have all day.
Okay, thank you. One moment while I pull up your order... Alright, I see the VeloBand Pulse you purchased. I understand you'd like to return it. Can you tell me why you're returning it?
It doesn't track my sleep properly and the heart rate monitor is inaccurate. Basically, it's just a useless smart watch. I want my money back.
I apologize that the VeloBand Pulse didn't meet your expectations. No problem at all. Our return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase.
90 days? Really? I thought it was a shorter window. I ordered it maybe two weeks ago... So can I just send it back?

Yes, absolutely. You are well within our return window. To initiate the return, I will email you a prepaid shipping label. Simply package the VeloBand Pulse securely, affix the label, and drop it off at your nearest shipping carrier location.
Okay, great! That sounds easy enough. How long will it take to get my refund?
Once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse, your refund will be processed within 7-10 business days. You'll receive an email notification when the refund has been issued.
Perfect. Thank you so much! I appreciate you helping me with this.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today regarding the VeloBand Pulse or any other VeloFit products?
Great! You'll receive the return label email shortly. Have a wonderful day!
